Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Look to the stars. Transcend the unknown. Illuminate answers hiding behind the veil of time. With art that feels torn from the pages of a modern spell book, the Tome of the Astral Sorceress lets you unlock your potential for celestial divination and glimpse gently into what may be. But take caution, knowing the future might make you change it . . .
Art by Helvetica Blanc
